description: Export captured network requests as a HAR 1.2 document (importable into Chrome DevTools / Charles). Covers ALL requests (the full network ring, independent of DEVLOOP_NET_THRESHOLD — bodies kept for the curated subset: failures + status ≥ threshold). To browse requests in JSON use get_network.
